headline: FedEx Invests $80M in New Global Capabilities Center in Mexico City
summary: FedEx has opened a new Global Capabilities Center in Mexico City following an $80 million investment, designed to support operations across 33 countries in the Americas.
why: Multinational logistics investments in regional service hubs enhance operational efficiency and cross-border supply chain coordination.

impacts.name: FedEx
impacts.why: Capital expenditure for a new operational hub supports long-term logistical capabilities across the Americas.
